title: A woman is being arrested or detained
triggers: police arresting a woman at night
my sister was taken by male police
can police arrest a woman after sunset
raat ko mahila ko giraftar kar rahe hain

rights.plain_explanation: Except in exceptional circumstances, no woman can be arrested after sunset and before sunrise. Even then, a woman officer must get prior written permission from a magistrate.
When a woman is arrested, she's presumed to submit on being told, and a male officer shouldn't touch her to make the arrest.
A medical examination of a woman must be done by, or under the supervision of, a female doctor.
A woman can't be made to come to the police station as a witness; she's questioned where she lives, unless she chooses to go.

do_now: If she's in danger right now, call 112.
Ask whether a woman officer is present, and whether there's a magistrate's permission for a night arrest.
Inform family and note the station she's taken to.
Ask for the grounds of arrest and a lawyer.
user_at_fault_cases: These protections govern how a woman is arrested. They don't cancel a lawful arrest made correctly.

escalation.label: Women Helpline
escalation.detail: Call 181 for support and to report misconduct.

escalation.label: Free legal aid
escalation.detail: Call NALSA on 15100 or visit your District Legal Services Authority (DLSA) at the district court. Women, children, people in custody and people below the income limit get a free lawyer.
